title: MON 16 NOV · SEO: Get more Google reviews
ig:
Happy customers rarely leave reviews. Unless you ask. ⭐

Reviews help you show up higher on Google Maps, and they're the first thing new customers read.

4 simple ways to get more:

1️⃣ Ask on the same day
Right after the service, while they're happy.

2️⃣ Send your direct review link on WhatsApp
Google Business Profile → "Ask for reviews" gives you a short link.

3️⃣ Put a review QR code at the counter
Right next to your payment QR.

4️⃣ Reply to every review
People leave reviews where they see the owner reads them.

❗ Never buy reviews or offer gifts for them. Google can remove them.

Save this for your team 📌

title: TUE 17 NOV · Social media: The best time to post
ig:
"What's the best time to post?" ⏰

The honest answer: it's different for every business.
And your account already knows.

Find yours in 1 minute:

📱 Instagram
Professional dashboard → Total followers → Most active times

📘 Facebook
Meta Business Suite → Insights → Audience

Then:
✅ Post about 30 minutes before your followers' busiest hour
✅ Test 2–3 time slots for a month
✅ Keep the time that brings the most comments and saves

Your followers' habits matter more than any "best time" list online.

title: WED 18 NOV · Website: 5 trust signals
ig:
People don't buy from websites they don't trust. 🔐

You have about 5 seconds to look real. These 5 signals help:

⭐ Real reviews
Show what customers say, with names (with permission).

📷 Real photos
Your shop, your team, your work. Not stock images.

📍 Address and map
Local customers want to know you're nearby and real.

🔒 The padlock (https)
Browsers warn visitors about sites without it.

💬 A real way to contact you
WhatsApp, a phone number someone answers, an email with your domain.

How many does your website have? Tell us below 👇

title: SAT 21 NOV · Brand: A logo isn't a brand
ig:
Your logo is not your brand. 🎨

A logo is a symbol. Your brand is what people feel when they see it.

Your brand is:
→ How fast you reply to a message
→ What customers say about you when you're not in the room
→ How your shop, website and posts look and feel
→ Using the same colours, fonts and voice everywhere

A great logo on a slow, inconsistent business is still a slow, inconsistent business.

Fix the experience first. Then the logo becomes something people remember for the right reasons.

title: MON 23 NOV · SEO: Turn phone questions into website FAQs
ig:
Every question customers ask you on the phone is a page waiting to rank on Google. 📞➡️🔍

"How much does it cost?"
"How long does it take?"
"Do you work on Sundays?"
"Is it painful?"

People type these exact questions into Google and ChatGPT before they call anyone.

Do this:
1️⃣ Write down every question customers ask this week
2️⃣ Answer each one clearly on your website (FAQ section or a short page)
3️⃣ Use the same words customers use

You'll get found more, and you'll answer the same question on the phone less.

title: FRI 27 NOV · Black Friday: offers that don't kill your margin
ig:
Black Friday doesn't have to mean a 50% discount. 🛍️

Big discounts bring bargain hunters, cut your margin and teach customers to wait for the next sale.

4 offers that sell more and protect your price:

🎁 A free add-on
Something small with the main service.

📦 A bundle
Two or three services together at a slightly better price.

💙 A bonus for existing customers
Reward the people who already trust you.

⏰ A short deadline
"This weekend only" gives people a reason to decide now.

title: MON 30 NOV · SEO: 5 things to check in Search Console every month
ig:
15 minutes a month in Google Search Console tells you what's working. 📊

Check these 5 on the 1st of every month:

1️⃣ Total clicks
Going up or down compared with last month?

2️⃣ Top search queries
What people actually type to find you. Often a surprise.

3️⃣ Pages with impressions but few clicks
People see them on Google but don't click. Improve the title and description.

4️⃣ Page indexing
Any important pages Google isn't showing?

5️⃣ Core Web Vitals
Speed and mobile issues that hold you back.

Don't have Search Console set up? That's step zero.

Save this for 1 December 📌
